# MoverScore

**MoverScore** (Zhao et al. 2019) is a [[SemanticSimilarity|semantic-similarity]] metric that uses *"embeddings generated by a mixture of algorithms"* ([[ai-engineering-ch03-evaluation-methodology|*AI Engineering* Ch 3]]) and Earth Mover's Distance (Wasserstein distance) to score candidate-to-reference similarity.

## How it differs from [[BERTScore]]

| Property | [[BERTScore]] | MoverScore |
|---|---|---|
| Embedding source | [[bert|BERT]] | Mixture of embedding algorithms |
| Aggregation | Greedy matching → precision/recall/F1 | Earth Mover's Distance over the embedding cloud |
| Sensitivity to length | Low | More robust to length differences |

The Earth Mover's framing means MoverScore considers the **whole distribution** of candidate-token embeddings rather than the best per-token pairing.

## Position

Ch 3 lists MoverScore alongside [[BERTScore]] as one of the two named *"metrics for semantic textual similarity"*. In practice, [[BERTScore]] is the more widely deployed of the two as of late 2024.
